name: manifest_db
description: Read an iOS backup's Manifest.db and turn the flat directory of hash-named files back into a file system: domain, relative path, size, flags and the file each hash actually is. Reports whether the backup is encrypted before anything else.

path.description: The backup directory, or its Manifest.db

contains.description: Case-insensitive regex over the relative path

domain.description: Only this domain, e.g. HomeDomain or AppDomain-com.example
